comparison.objective: Set and lock a gripper stop versus orient and fit two bevelled steel coupons to a specified weld root gap.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses concentric rotary tools; weld fit-up uses reorientation and millimetre-scale planar alignment of two loose parts.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a retained angular stop over cycles; weld fit-up requires facing bevels, 1.6–3.2 mm openings at both ends, aligned ends, flatness, and stillness.
comparison.reason: Both involve numerical setup, but weld coupon alignment does not involve locking a setting or resisting tightening reaction.
